title: dryopteris ochrorachis
intro:
Dryopteris ochrorachis, commonly known as the Chinese golden shield fern, is a type of flowering plant in the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris ochrorachis include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.

However, please note that more research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using Dryopteris ochrorachis for medicinal purposes.
